confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Rome price levels, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely by area and date. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the draft-beer example (cocktail about 1.8x beer, house wine about equal to beer). EUR figures were converted at an assumed working rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR. The FX value is taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as reported in search results; the F11.1 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Rome's own centro-storico price levels, cross-checked against other large Italian tourist cities such as Florence and Milan. Hotel and hostel figures reflect July peak-season demand.
